content: Gerbil: two-phase minimizer partitioning (reader->parser->splitter->writer builds super-mer bins; phase2 routes k-mers by hash to hasher threads, GPU open-addressing quadratic-probe insertion). ~50% runtime is I/O, threads idle >75% (NSF PAR). DGerbil/AdaOrder balances bins by sampling+penalizing high-load minimizers. CPU partitioning structure transfers to rustkmer; GPU is anti-feature (no GPU dep, PyO3 wheel, speedup vanishes large k).
